transcript.text:
Thank you both for those critical updates. Let me summarize where we stand on each agenda item:

1. Microphone setup: Jonah, you've reported that wireless microphones are unreliable due to RF interference from the neighboring broadcast compound, and the Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones. Noted.

2. Recording format: Elena, you've confirmed the appearance release permits audio-only recording and prohibits public video release. So the recording format must be audio-only. Noted.

3. Podcast release date: Elena, you've confirmed the release allows the podcast episode to be released only on September 15, 2026. Noted.

4. Status-report entries: This is where we have a problem. Both of you have indicated your recorded status-report entries are not yet fully submitted — Jonah, your survey report is awaiting upload; Elena, you still need to formally submit yours. Per the festival's standard production meeting requirements, I need both the sound and rights leads' recorded status-report entries submitted before I can sign off on the plan. So I cannot approve the final production and release plan today.

Here's what I need from each of you: Jonah, please complete the upload of your RF survey report and formally submit your recorded status-report entry. Elena, please formally submit your recorded status-report entry, including the rights confirmation details you just shared. Once both entries are submitted, I can review them and approve the plan with the following terms: four wired microphones, audio-only recording format, and a podcast release date of September 15, 2026. Please let me know as soon as those submissions are complete.
